testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the context menu for an Origin plane: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:528:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the context menu for an Origin plane ✔ Given a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser ✔ And Auto-Resize is enabled for the YZ Plane in the captured session ✔ When the user right-clicks the YZ Plane row ✔ Then a context menu opens beside the plane row ✔ And the menu offers New Sketch, Measure, Visibility and Auto-Resize ✔ And Auto-Resize is checked in this session ✔ And the plane row is highlighted ✔ And the corresponding plane is highlighted as a blue translucent surface in the viewport ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu ✔ Then the context menu closes ✔ And the plane row and translucent plane remain highlighted ✔ When the user clicks the empty viewport area again ✔ Then the plane selection is cleared ✔ And the highlighted plane is no longer displayed ✔ And the solid remains visible
